name: go-grpc
description: > gRPC services in Go beyond the basics: proto design, status codes and error details, interceptors, deadlines, streaming, health checks, and graceful shutdown. Use when: "gRPC service", "proto design", "gRPC error handling", "interceptor", "gRPC streaming", "gRPC deadline", "grpc health check", "gRPC status codes". Do NOT use for: REST/HTTP handler design (use go-api-design), protobuf-agnostic API layering (use go-architecture-review), or TLS hardening details (use go-security-audit).
author: eduardo-sl
summary_zh: 面向 Go 的 gRPC 服务进阶实践指南，适合设计协议、处理错误、流式通信、超时控制、健康检查与优雅停机。
